payload.question: How wide should the #2348 change be? The shared `isKeywordGrantOrNegationPhrase(keyword, text)` helper plus deleting the two bespoke lists is uncontroversial. The open question is whether the same PR also wires the new guard into the four gates that currently lack one, and whether it unifies their divergent copies.
options: B (recommended): shared helper + delete both bespoke lists AND wire the guard into the four ungated live gates (mutate, prowess, shroud, hexproof), plus the two low-risk alignment fixes (evergreen.hasShroud anchoring, getTargetingRestrictions hexproof line). Closes the documented KNOWN LIMITs in the same issue that exists to close them; requires rewriting ~4 pinned tests. Leaves the divergent shroud/hexproof copies structurally separate for a follow-up.

A (minimal): shared helper + delete both bespoke lists only. Pure refactor, zero behavior change, no test pins touched. Leaves mutate/shroud/hexproof knowingly wrong with a now-obsolete 'needs a grant-aware parse' comment pointing at a helper that already exists.

C (widest): B, plus move the composed hasShroud/hasHexproof gates into their keyword-actions leaves so both call sites delegate (mirroring indestructible #2350). Fixes the divergence class properly, but touches two additional live gates and their test suites in one PR.
